papers.title: Evaluating mental health integration in PrEP programs to reduce HIV incidence among US gay and bisexual men: a network modeling study.
papers.abstract: Despite advances in HIV prevention, achieving elimination in the United States (US) remains challenging, particularly among gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM). Psychosocial barriers, including stigma and mental health challenges, influence sexual behaviors and hinder engagement in HIV prevention and care, suggesting that integrated interventions may improve HIV-related service uptake and reduce HIV incidence. We adapted a stochastic network model simulating HIV transmission dynamics in a southeastern US metro to include individual-level sexual stigma and mental health factors impacting HIV risk and service engagement. The model assessed the impact of integrating routine mental health screening and resilience-building mental health care into PrEP programs and evaluated intervention effects on HIV incidence over ten years. Enhancements in mental health services alone led to modest reductions in HIV incidence, averting 12% of new infections with maximum improvements in depression diagnosis and treatment initiation across the general GBMSM population. However, integrated strategies combining mental health care with expanded PrEP and ART coverage resulted in up to a 41% reduction in HIV incidence when targeted at all HIV-negative individuals within PrEP settings, reaching a final-year incidence rate of 0.52 per 100 person-years. Integrating mental health care into PrEP programs is an important step but it is not sufficient to achieve substantial reductions in HIV incidence. Substantial declines require broader engagement in both PrEP and ART, with a coordinated approach that addresses mental health alongside these HIV prevention strategies.
papers.summary: 本研究透過隨機網路模型，模擬美國東南部都會區男男性行為者（GBMSM）的HIV傳播動態，探討將常規心理健康篩檢與照護整合至暴露前預防性投藥（PrEP）計畫的效果。研究發現，僅提升心理健康服務能適度減少12%的新增感染；但若將心理健康照護與擴大PrEP及抗反轉錄病毒治療（ART）涵蓋率結合，針對PrEP環境中的HIV陰性個體進行整合干預，能在十年內將HIV發生率降低高達41%。
papers.classification: 公共衛生與傳染病防治
papers.significance: 此研究強調單純依賴心理健康服務並不足以大幅降低HIV發生率，其意義在於揭示了多管齊下的協調性干預策略的必要性。結果為未來公共衛生政策提供重要證據，表明要有效控制甚至消除HIV，必須在擴大PrEP與ART覆蓋率的同時，一併解決污名化與心理健康等社會心理障礙。

papers.title: Implementing after action review in an Irish tertiary hospital: a mixed-methods evaluation of safety culture and second victim experience and support.
papers.abstract: Evidence for After Action Reviews (AAR), a non-hierarchical debriefing approach, is limited. We explored AAR implementation and measured safety culture and second victim experience and support, before and after introduction of AAR at an Irish hospital. A mixed-methods study which coincided with the COVID-19 pandemic and a health system cyber-attack was conducted. Hospital selected staff were trained as AAR facilitators using a simulation-based programme (July-Sept 2021). The intervention was the hospital introduction of AAR over 12-months (Sept 2021-Aug 2022). Before training, the Hospital Survey on Patient Safety 2.0 (HSOPS 2.0) and Second Victim Experience and Support Tool (SVEST) were distributed to all staff (N = 586), and repeated at 12-months with additional questions on AAR awareness, frequency and duration. At 6-months, focus groups with trained facilitators explored implementation enablers and barriers. Costs were estimated. Quantitative analysis used chi-squared, Fisher's exact and t-tests to compare pre-/post- responses. Qualitative data was analysed using the Capability, Opportunity, Motivation - Behaviour (COM-B) model. Findings were integrated via triangulation, and the level of implementation was categorised using Roger's theory of the diffusion of innovations. Nine per cent (n = 50) of staff were trained as AAR facilitators. Survey response rates were 33% pre- and 16% post- AAR implementation. After 12-months, 37% of staff were aware of AAR and 10% had participated in one, at €48 average cost. Approximately, 39 AARs were conducted. The ratio of informal to formal AARs was 2.6:1. No change in overall safety culture occurred despite a pandemic and cyber-attack. Response to error improved. Triangulation of results confirmed improvement in response to error was associated with staff awareness and participation in AAR. Second victim experience and support showed no change in psychological and physical distress, yet professional self-efficacy, perceived organisational support and turnover intentions worsened, with no observed association with AAR. Simulation-based training and national-level policy supported early adoption of AAR. Implementation of AAR was associated with improved response to error at the hospital, but not second victim experiences.
papers.summary: 本研究採用混合方法評估愛爾蘭一家三級醫院引入「行動後審查（AAR）」非層級檢討機制對安全文化與第二受害者經驗的影響。研究在 COVID-19 疫情與網路攻擊期間進行，培訓了 9% 的員工作為引導者。經過 12 個月的實施，約 37% 的員工知曉該機制，10% 參與其中（平均每次成本 48 歐元）。結果顯示，儘管面臨外部危機，整體安全文化未發生顯著變化，但在「對錯誤的反應」方面有所改善，且與員工對 AAR 的認知與參與度直接相關。然而，第二受害者在心理困擾、專業自我效能感及離職意向等方面的支持體驗並未改善，部分指標甚至惡化，且與 AAR 實施無關聯。
papers.significance: 此研究為醫療機構的非層級檢討機制（AAR）提供了實證基礎，證實其在危機期間能有效改善員工對醫療錯誤的應對能力。對於醫療管理者而言，這表明低成本的 AAR 機制（每次 48 歐元）可作為提升特定安全文化維度的有效工具；但同時亦發出警示，AAR 無法自動解決員工（第二受害者）的心理支持與職業認同問題，機構在推行此類機制時，需額外搭配專門的心理支持與組織關懷策略，以避免員工自我效能感下降與離職率上升。

papers.title: Barriers to AI-supported health management among older adults with chronic orthopedic conditions in China: implications for healthcare delivery and access.
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied in chronic disease management, yet its adoption among older adults with chronic orthopedic conditions remains limited and poorly understood in China. A qualitative study using semi-structured interviews was conducted with 13 older adults recruited from two tertiary hospitals in Beijing and Harbin. Thematic analysis was performed to identify key themes. Five themes were identified: (1) preference for traditional health management over AI; (2) limited understanding of AI-supported health management; (3) perceived constraints in technological capability and affordability; (4) lack of external support from family and community; and (5) optimistic yet unrealistic expectations of AI capabilities. Older adults with chronic orthopedic conditions face structural barriers to adopting AI-supported health management. Effective implementation requires age-friendly design and stronger integration within primary healthcare systems.
papers.summary: 本研究針對中國13名患有慢性骨科疾病的老年人進行訪談，發現該族群在採用AI輔助健康管理時面臨五大結構性障礙：偏好傳統管理方式、對AI認知有限、技術與經濟負擔受限、缺乏家庭與社區支持，以及對AI能力抱持不切實際的期望。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了AI在慢性病管理落地時針對老年族群面臨的實際障礙，強調未來AI醫療工具的開發必須導入「適老化」設計，並呼籲強化與基層醫療系統的整合，以提升醫療服務的普及性與可及性。

papers.title: Who benefits more from an improved social health insurance? Evidence from supplementary high-cost illness insurance in China.
papers.abstract: China introduced the Supplementary High-Cost Illness Insurance (SHCII) to strengthen financial protection against medical impoverishment. This study assesses its effectiveness and, critically, examines the distribution of its benefits across population subgroups to identify who benefits more. We used 2013 and 2018 survey data from Shandong Province and a difference‑in‑differences design, restricting the sample to hospitalized patients (n = 3,136). The treatment group comprised patients whose out‑of‑pocket expenses exceeded city‑specific 2018 SHCII thresholds; the control group comprised those below the thresholds. The outcome was Vulnerability to Expected Poverty (VEP). Subgroup analyses were performed by income, urban‑rural residence, healthcare access, and age. Patients who benefit from SHCII experienced a significant reduction in VEP relative to those below the threshold (OR = 0.624; average marginal effect = -0.064). The protective effect was statistically significant for low‑income individuals, rural residents, those with healthcare access within 15 min, and adults aged 45 years and above. No significant effect was found for urban residents or for those with poorer geographical access to care. Patients who benefit from SHCII experienced a greater reduction in poverty vulnerability relative to those below the threshold, with effects concentrated among low‑income, rural, older, and well‑accessed populations. No significant association was observed for urban residents. The findings from Shandong, where policy parameters are broadly consistent with national guidelines, are likely generalizable to other provinces with similar policy designs and rural healthcare infrastructure. Future research is needed to test how different policy parameters affect the results. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究探討中國「補充大病保險」（SHCII）在減輕醫療致貧風險方面的成效及其受益群體分佈。透過分析山東省2013至2018年的住院患者調查數據，採用雙重差分法發現，自付醫療費用超過補充保險門檻的患者，其預期貧困脆弱性（VEP）顯著降低。亞組分析顯示，該保險的保護效應主要集中在低收入者、農村居民、45歲以上成年人以及醫療可及性較好的群體，而對城市居民及醫療地理可及性較差的群體則無顯著影響。
papers.significance: 此研究對於優化社會健康保險制度具有重要政策意義。研究結果揭示了當前補充大病保險在減輕醫療負擔時存在明顯的異質性，雖然成功保護了農村與弱勢群體，卻未能惠及城市居民，顯示出保險設計可能存在城鄉覆蓋不均的盲區。這為未來調整保險參數、改善城市醫療可及性及促進健康保障公平性提供了關鍵的實證依據。

papers.title: How place, trust, and care location influence rural and non-metropolitan patients' preferences for decentralized long-acting injectable HIV therapy: A mixed-methods study.
papers.abstract: Long-acting injectable antiretroviral therapy (LAI-ART) offers an alternative to daily oral ART and may reduce pill fatigue, stigma, and daily treatment burden. However, its implementation in rural and non-metropolitan settings is challenged by travel burden, limited local healthcare infrastructure, and privacy concerns. This study evaluated interest in, and preferences for cabotegravir/rilpivirine (CAB + RPV LA) among people with HIV (PWH) living outside a metropolitan area and identified factors influencing uptake. From March 2024 through December 2024 we conducted a cross-sectional mixed-methods study, using an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design. We surveyed 102 PWH receiving care at a Midwestern HIV specialty clinic, followed by qualitative interviews with approximately 10% of respondents. Surveys assessed sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of CAB + RPV LA, perceived appropriateness, facilitators, barriers, and location preferences. Quantitative analyses used chi-square, Wilcoxon, and Kruskal-Wallis tests. Interviews were thematically analyzed through iterative deductive and inductive coding. Participants had a median age of 51; 83.3% were male, 72.5% non-Hispanic White, and 44% self-identified as rural. Awareness of CAB + RPV LA was high (72.5%), and 63.7% expressed interest in switching. Interest was associated with younger age, shorter duration since HIV diagnosis, higher perceived appropriateness, and benefits such as reduced pill burden. Barriers included injection fear, concerns about prolonged side effects, and increased clinic visits. Most participants (63.7%) preferred local injection sites, influenced strongly by travel time, convenience, and feeling safe in their community. Qualitative interviews emphasized pill fatigue, trust in providers, and privacy considerations as major drivers of acceptability. High interest in CAB + RPV LA among non-metropolitan PWH underscores the need for flexible, decentralized delivery models that reduce logistical barriers while maintaining trusted provider relationships.
papers.summary: 本研究針對鄉村與非都會區的HIV患者，探討其對長效注射抗逆轉錄病毒療法（LAI-ART）的接受度與偏好。透過針對102名患者的混合方法研究發現，高達72.5%的患者知曉此療法，且63.7%有意願轉換治療，其主要動機為減輕服藥疲勞。然而，患者普遍偏好在地化、去中心化的注射地點，主要考量因素包括就醫的交通便利性、社區安全感、對醫療人員的信任度以及隱私保護，而對注射的恐懼與長期副作用則是主要障礙。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了去中心化醫療交付模式在偏鄉地區的重要性。隨著LAI-ART等創新療法的問世，若能將注射服務下放至社區，不僅能消除地理與交通上的就醫障礙，還能維持患者與原本信賴的醫療提供者之間的關係。這對於優化醫療資源配置、提升偏鄉HIV患者的治療順從性及整體公共衛生成效具有關鍵的參考價值。

papers.title: Loneliness is Associated with Altered Interoceptive Appraisal and Attenuated Prefrontal Heartbeat-Evoked Potentials.
papers.abstract: Loneliness is associated with heightened affective sensitivity and increased vulnerability to stress, yet its psychophysiological mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Drawing on the three-dimensional model of interoception (Garfinkel et al., 2015), the present study examined whether loneliness is associated with variation in interoceptive sensibility (self-report), interoceptive accuracy (behavioral), and cortical processing of cardiac signals (heartbeat-evoked potential; HEP). Two primary hypotheses were tested: higher loneliness would be associated with lower interoceptive sensibility, particularly in dimensions involving emotional and regulatory appraisal of bodily states; and higher loneliness would be associated with attenuated resting-state HEP amplitude over fronto-central electrodes. Thirty-nine healthy adults completed the Multidimensional Assessment of Interoceptive Awareness (MAIA), heartbeat counting (HBC) and heartbeat discrimination (HBD) tasks, and resting-state EEG with simultaneous ECG recording. HEPs were analyzed using cluster-based permutation test, and source localization was performed using sLORETA. The first hypothesis was partially supported: four MAIA subscales - Not Worrying, Emotional Awareness, Self-Regulation, and Trusting - showed significant negative correlation with loneliness, whereas interoceptive accuracy was not significantly associated with loneliness. The second hypothesis was supported: higher loneliness was associated with attenuated late HEP amplitudes over left frontal electrodes, with source localization implicating the left dorsolateral cortex (DLPFC). The HEP-loneliness association remained significant after controlling for depressive symptoms and demographic factors (sex and age). These findings are consistent with a regulation-based account in which loneliness is associated with altered appraisal and impaired higher-order cortical processing of bodily signals, a pattern consistent with the hypervigilance model of loneliness.
papers.summary: 本研究基於內感受的三維模型，探討孤獨感與內感受敏感性、準確性及心跳誘發電位（HEP）之間的關聯。針對39名健康成年人的研究發現，孤獨感與「不擔心」、「情緒覺察」、「自我調節」及「信任」等內感受敏感性維度呈顯著負相關，但與行為上的內感受準確性無顯著關聯。此外，孤獨感較高者在左側額葉電極的晚期HEP振幅較弱，源定位顯示涉及左側背外側前額葉（DLPFC），且此關聯在控制憂鬱症狀與人口統計變項後依然顯著。
papers.significance: 此研究從神經生理學角度揭示了孤獨感的潛在機制，證實孤獨感與身體信號評估的改變及高階皮層處理受損有關。這項發現支持了孤獨感的過度警覺模型與基於調節的解釋，有助於未來針對孤獨感建立客觀的生理指標測量，並為開發相關的心理干預策略提供理論基礎。
